notes: Sounds: EXTRAS > SFX lists the .wav files in /sfx and plays them through the speaker; the first row is the test tone. The AMP chip there keeps the amp on all the time instead of resting after two seconds of quiet -- try it if the speaker is silent.
Speaker: a short pause after the amp wakes, so a quick effect no longer loses its start.
Options: the wheel wears the guild -- plates in the guild's edge colour, the highlight in its accent.
Theme: the guild picker is a wheel of eleven wedges, each in its own two colours; turn or tap, the screen repaints in it, tap the hub to keep it, hold the knob to put it back.
